comment: Takeoff - risers and downlifters that only add sound on top (the input passes through untouched, stereo). The sound is noise through a resonant sweeping filter, shaped by Color, Wind and Grain. Range sets how far it travels. Var makes each takeoff a little different (Range, start pitch, curve, Color, Wind, Grain, a pan drift; drawn once per sweep, never Len, Dir or Vol; 0 = the same every time). Volume swells with the sweep, width grows, exponential curve. Dir UP sweeps up and cuts clean at the end, DOWN starts at the top and falls and fades. Space = reverb tail on the riser's own sound. The sweep starts and ends on the input's strongest note (listened to all the time; FREE when there is no clear note). QUANT: an on/off flip waits for the end of the current Len cycle (the MIDI clock's bar grid, or the cycle of the first sweep), a flip during a sweep drops it at once, holding the footswitch (needs the MOD firmware) rises while held and drops on release. MOD firmware: the footswitch LED pulses while a sweep waits and fades with the sweep.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 494 Takeoff, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack; 494 was the dropped SyncEQ, 498-500 are probes). Not checked against the stock ZDLs on this PC (none present): run build/extract_effect_db.py with stock_zdls/ to confirm.

params.name: Dir
params.comment: 0 UP: sweeps up and cuts clean at the end (the drop). 1 DOWN: starts at the top, falls and fades to silence. Default UP.

params.name: Len
params.comment: Sweep length, and the QUANT cycle. 0..4 = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 bars at the pedal's tempo (MIDI clock, tap or patch). 5..35 = FREE, 1..31 seconds. Default 2 = 4 bars.

params.name: Color
params.comment: Noise filter width: 0 = a narrow whistling band, 100 = wide air. Level stays about the same. Default 25.

params.name: Wind
params.comment: Organic motion of the noise: slow random gusts move its level and filter, separately left and right. 0 = steady. Default 40.

params.name: Grain
params.comment: Grit of the noise: 0 = smooth white noise, up = held random steps (sample and hold), from sand to crackle. Default 0.

params.name: Range
params.comment: How far the noise sweep travels (the filter's move from start to end), 0..100 = 0..5 octaves. Small = a short, subtle lift; 100 = from deep rumble to full air. Default 60 = 3 octaves.

params.name: Var
params.comment: How much each takeoff differs from the last, so a live set does not repeat itself. Drawn once when a sweep starts: Range (x 1 +-0.35), start pitch, curve shape, Color, Wind and Grain, a little stereo drift. Never Len, Dir or Vol; the level stays about the same. 0 = the same takeoff every time. Default 35.

params.name: Space
params.comment: Reverb tail on the riser's own sound only, ringing on after the cut. 0 = off. Default 0.

params.name: Vol
params.comment: Level of the added sound (linear). The input is never changed. Default 50.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate, not measured. The cost is mostly fetching the code from slow memory, about a cycle per byte a block runs (as Washout and DJFilter). The old build ran about 10 KB of its 12.9 KB of audio code a block while sounding (about 18%). This build is compiled for size (7.9 KB) and works out knobs, BPM, the Var draws and the root note only when they change, so a block runs about 3 KB idle (key listener only, about 5.5%) and about 5 KB sounding with Space and the LED (about 9%, about 11% while a knob turns). Declared for the worst case at cycles / 75 x 1.25. Re-measure on the pedal (SYSTEM > LOAD).
